name: synter-loop-workers
description: Cloudflare Workers for synter-loop: the site (landing page, /live) and agent-capture (run capture, D1 index, sGTM relay, live feed).

scripts.test: vitest run -c capture/vitest.config.ts && vitest run -c site/vitest.config.ts
scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run -c capture/wrangler.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry/capture && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c site/wrangler.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry/site
scripts.verify: npm run guards && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.d1:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply agent_runs --remote -c capture/wrangler.jsonc
